# Method IsNCFile

#### IsNCFile(ElementId)

Tells whether an element is a NC file.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 9, 0, 0)]
bool IsNCFile(ElementId inElementId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the element to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  True if the element is a NC file.  |
